card.name: Slot before 'reported' or 'experienced'
card.fires_on: The word or bracket right after a group of patients or users, just before a verb like reported, experienced or complained. It marks the spot where a report of an effect is about to be stated.

modes.label: Patient group then report
modes.description: Subject phrase about patients or users, ending just before 'have reported' or 'experienced'.

modes.label: Adverb or placebo slot
modes.description: Adverbs, placebo or 'none' placed just before a verb of experiencing an effect.
modes.example: Clinical study subjects who received single 50 mg oral doses of zolmitriptan tablets<< commonly>> experienced sedation.

card.writes: It pushes the model to produce report and complaint words such as reports, reported and complaints.
card.plain: It fires where a sentence is about to say that some patients reported or complained of an effect.
